content: गुञ्जा [गुञ्ज्-अच्] .²1 A small shrub of that name, bearing a red black berry; अन्तर्विषमया (for ˚य्यः) ह्येता बहिश्चैव मनोरमाः . गुञ्जाफलसमाकारा योषितः केन निर्मिताः .. <ls>Pt. 1. 196</ls>; किं जातु गुञ्जाफलभूषणानां सुवर्णकारेण वनेचराणाम् <ls>Vikr. 1. 25</ls>. .²2 A berry of this shrub used as a weight, measuring on an average 1⁵⁄₁₆ grains Troy, or an artificial weight called {%Gunja%} measuring about 2³⁄₁₆ grains. .²3 Humming, a low murmuring sound. .²4 A kettle-drum; … गुञ्जा जुगुञ्जुः करघट्टिताः <ls>Bk. 14. 2</ls>. .²5 A tavern. .²6 Reflection, meditation. .²7 A kind of plant with a poisonous root.
